name: Shopify specialist
summary: Sets up, changes and checks Shopify stores: theme edits, sections and launch checks. Makes small changes safely without piling on apps.

changelog.note: Added buyer-trial scope checks for browser initialization, resource creation, transaction replay and final request-log reconciliation.

First release: theme architecture and safe editing, speed and Core Web Vitals, app code clean-up, access levels 1 to 3 per tool (read, draft, publish within limits), launch and sale-day checks, checkout and Scripts deadlines, and US, UK and EU rules on prices, cookies and accessibility, with 30 checked sources.
